summary: Batch #36 — Task Nudge + Helper Alert Taps (focus=msg_id) + Calendar Week & Day views. BACKEND (/app/backend/tests/test_batch36_task_nudge_helper_focus.py): 6/6 pytest pass, 1 skipped in ~3.4s. Covered: (a) POST /todos/items/{id}/nudge as parent on OPEN task with assignee -> {nudged:1, name:'Priya'} AND a '⏰ Reminder from Raj: @Priya, please finish "…" 🙏' message inserted into db.messages family chat (verified by mongo probe). (b) Task with NO assignee -> {nudged:0, name:'the family'} still posts to family chat. (c) Done task -> 400 'That task is already done'. (d) Unknown item_id -> 404 'Task not found'. (e) Helper notifications feed — chat and care_team items ALL carry a `message_id` field AND `route` ends with `?focus=<message_id>` (e.g. `/helper-portal/chat?focus=msg_...`, `/helper-portal/care-team?focus=ctm_...`), while non-message items (handover/rating) keep their plain routes with NO `focus=` suffix. (f) SECURITY regression: a family-chat `db.messages` probe row is NOT surfaced in the helper feed (verified by unique-marker scan). Only test skipped: the 403-when-child-nudges-others-task case — the demo family's child accounts don't expose an auth flow (/api/personas/switch isn't available), so we couldn't obtain a child token. Backend code inspection confirms the guard at server.py:2772-2774 (mine.role in {admin,parent} OR aid==mine.member_id -> else 403), which was already curl-verified by main agent. FRONTEND (Playwright mobile 390x844): 1) HOME Task Nudge — as storytester (parent), 'Family tasks' section shows 3 `task-nudge-<item_id>` Remind pills; tapping one displays `home-toast` with text '⏰ Reminder sent to Priya' and calls the nudge API. 2) CALENDAR — segmented switch cal-view-month / cal-view-week / cal-view-day all visible. Month view: 5 cal-member-* avatars + 42 day-YYYY-MM-DD cells + event pills + fab-create-event + hero label 'August' with year '2026'. Week view: hero label '16–22 Aug', 7 week-day-YYYY-MM-DD rows each showing time+title (or 'No events') e.g. 'SUN 16 16:00 Football Practice', 'SAT 22 No events'; tapping a week row switches to Day view for that date (URL/hero updates to 'Sun, 16 Aug'). Day view: single-day agenda with 'Football Practice' event, RSVP pills (Going/Maybe/Can't), Remind pill; hero shows 'Sun, 16 Aug' with sub 'August 2026'. Prev/Today/Next arrows (cal-prev/cal-today/cal-next) work in all three views. 3) HELPER Alert Taps — Welcome -> 'I'm a trusted helper' -> sunita/1234; portal shows header bell (helper-notif-btn) with a red '2' unread badge from freshly-seeded TEST_B36 messages; Chat card badge '3', Care Team card badge '1'. Tapping bell -> /helper-portal/notifications lists 20 helper-notif-<i> alert rows including 'Raj · Care Team · TEST_B36_CT_1997a8' (freshest, highlighted as unread). Tapping the Care Team row navigates to `https://our-story-191.preview.emergentagent.com/helper-portal/care-team?focus=ctm_c8e580e734ed48d3` — URL correctly carries `?focus=<message_id>`; the Care Team screen renders 20 ctmsg-<message_id> bubbles including the referenced 'TEST_B36_CT_1997a8' message visible at the bottom of the viewport (scroll-to-target working). No red screen, media playback controls (voice/photo bubbles) all render, helper media token load OK. Verdict: Batch #36 fully passes.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2759-2797 /todos/items/{id}/nudge — correct: 404 when item missing, 400 when done, 403 unless role in {admin,parent} OR the acting user IS the assignee, posts one message to the family chat (`⏰ Reminder from <name>: @<who>, please finish "<title>" 🙏`), updates chats.last_message, fires a push best-effort with idempotency key `tasknudge_<item>_<yyyy-mm-ddThh>` so accidental multi-taps within an hour don't spam. Return shape `{nudged: 0|1, name: str}` matches spec.
